integrity: Analytic universal upper bound and explicit pendant/twin-reducible examples; bundled independent-of-package-dependencies witness verifier. Finite checks do not establish novelty or replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graphs; open neighborhoods of fixed four-element parameter subsets. Does not bound general parameter sizes, equality-sensitive full types, closed neighborhoods or distances. Thirteen-vertex extremizer order not claimed minimal. Priority remains subject to independent literature audit.
title: Sharp four-parameter neighborhood-profile spectrum in rank-width-one graphs
